name: After-action lesson
description: Capture one non-obvious reusable lesson from meaningful work
 title: "Lesson: "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## Situation

What happened? Link exact issues, pull requests, commits, deployments, workflow runs, or reproduction evidence.

## Reusable lesson

State one concise lesson that should help a future worker make a better decision.

## Scope and limits

Where does this apply, and when would applying it be wrong or excessive?

## Durable follow-up

Choose the smallest useful mechanism:

- [ ] This issue is sufficient.
- [ ] Add or strengthen a test.
- [ ] Update a runbook or command.
- [ ] Open a product, contract, or operating-protocol proposal.
- [ ] Request an independent audit.
- [ ] Create a durable note from `docs/institutional-memory/templates/after-action-note.md` and add it to the index.

## Content minimisation

Do not include credentials, raw tokens, unrestricted personal data, raw provider payloads, or unbounded transcripts.

## Authority boundary

A lesson is descriptive. It does not grant authority or silently change product or operating policy.
